method: Read the complete Chinese and previous English bodies for each of the five essays. Translated all 298 Chinese paragraphs individually, preserving their order, emphasis and links. Reread every saved English paragraph in full after writing, with the already-read Chinese argument and its qualifications as the authority. Checked exact source hashes, paragraph counts, per-paragraph strong/em/a counts and href equality. These mechanical checks are structural evidence, not a substitute for the substantive reading.

findings: Replaced the 17-paragraph adaptation with all 71 source paragraphs; removed its invented manager example and added moral/social commentary.
Restored the two-o’clock alarm and three-year commute examples, the begetter argument, lawmakers’ evidence, and virtue/vice symmetry.
Restored the unresolved Rackham/Ross quotation boundary and Bywater punctuation qualification.
anchors: The eye is on the rejected branch under either editorial division; adopting Rackham is not textual verification.
No motor concerns cognition alone; practical freedom is assigned elsewhere, not overlooked or already supplied.
Actions and dispositions differ in voluntariness; imperceptible increments distinguish original control from present availability.

findings: Restored all 54 paragraphs, including Euripides, the sequence of questions in V.9, and the three distinct answers in V.11.
Removed invented abuse, addiction, perfectionism, self-promise and temporal-self discussions; restored proofreading and procrastination examples.
Restored the First Critique link and the final distinction between a registered upper limit and an as-yet-unwritten relational diagram.
anchors: SAE never asserts that questioning requires two people: a different position is not a head count.
Aristotle changes the relation’s status to analogy; reflexive questioning remains the same operation with limited independent checking power.
The essay asks about shared premises, addresses and information routes without claiming the upstream reflexivity postulate owes a partition of the soul.

findings: Restored 70 paragraphs and all four opening objections, explicitly preserving the question/answer boundary.
Removed invented optimization, authenticity, outsourcing and management discussion; restored the capable operator and twenty-year habit examples.
Restored the complete base-work checklist, the three classifications, and the contrast between what is already visible and what can appear at all.
anchors: Cleverness and formal derivation are practical counterparts, not identical operations.
Virtue conditions the appearance of the right starting point, rather than merely recognizing a separately presented target.
SAE recognizes by work rather than origin; its theorem addresses presented candidates, not the conditions deciding what can reach presentation.

findings: Restored 56 paragraphs, including the two-level attribution of the Socrates account and the combined rejection-and-reframing sentence.
Restored the decisive difference between possession without use and beginner recitation without possession, which the adaptation blurred.
Removed invented smoking, vocabulary-password and institutional-training examples; restored office questioning, review, the four-field address, and the separately reconstructible inventory.
anchors: Only one layer of Socrates is rescued, not the intact denial of akrasia.
The evidence/possession parallel belongs to distinction four, not distinction one; no accusation of lying is implied.
A retrospective address records actual use, not all that was within reach; a separate inventory is possible but fallible, and no erasure through forgetting guarantees access at action time.

findings: Restored all 47 paragraphs, including Euripides, the concession of utility and pleasure friends, and the sequence from activity to shared awareness.
Removed invented claims about consent, exclusion, shared jokes, and a purported reconciliation with Book X.
Restored the narrow scope of the SAE comparison, the separate review qualifications, the complete list of cited interfaces, and the need for a measure before declaring a lack.
anchors: Book IX is not a repair of forgotten solitude in Book I; Book IX/X reconciliation is explicitly left undecided.
Independent checking is not replacement content; living together and settlement of validity remain different.
Only the SAE passages invoked here fail to supply shared living as a constituent of a good life; the essay does not condemn the entire framework as friendless.

corrections: EP07 final reread: used master and slave consistently for the Aristotelian analogy.
EP08 final reread: smoothed the awkward route phrase without changing the cleverness/target distinction.
EP09 final reread: changed the pivotal translated sentence to a single comma-linked sentence, consistent with the source’s explicit punctuation claim.
EP10 final reread: corrected the grammatical coordination in the pleasure-friends qualification.
unresolved: EP06 intentionally retains the unsettled Rackham/Ross quotation boundary; the essay adopts one division without presenting it as a verified textual fact.
EP10 intentionally declines to adjudicate how Book IX and Book X fit together.
scope_limits: No independent Greek-edition verification was performed; this task restores the Chinese essay faithfully, including its stated textual qualifications.
Only ep06–ep10 English translation JSON files and this review file were written. No HTML, Chinese, generator, or git commit was changed during this review.

post_batch_independent_corrections.issue: Restored mind the heat / complain of hunger rather than not feel heat or hunger.
多说了 means an overclaim, not merely saying more.
